scenes.text: Model card 1: how many faces does a cube have? Let us think carefully. A cube has 6 faces. The answer is 6. Great work!
Model card 2: how many faces does a cuboid have? Let us think carefully. A cuboid has 6 faces. The answer is 6. Great work!
Model card 3: how many faces does a square pyramid have? Let us think carefully. A square pyramid has 5 faces. The answer is 5. Great work!
Model card 4: how many flat circular faces does a cylinder have? Let us think carefully. A cylinder has 2 flat circular faces. The answer is 2. Great work!
